name.ja: Figure-rise Standard ベジータ (NEW SPEC Ver.)

description.ja: 可動域と造形美を極めた“NEW SPEC”シリーズ第２弾！『ドラゴンボールZ』よりベジータ(NEW SPEC Ver.)が登場！
description.en: The second installment of the “NEW SPEC” series with the ultimate in range of motion and beauty! Vegeta (NEW SPEC Ver.) appears from "Dragon Ball Z"!

description.ja: • マッスルビルドシステムがパワーアップ！「マッスルビルドシステムPLUS」を新たに搭載。
description.en: • Muscle build system is powered up! Newly equipped with "Muscle Build System PLUS".

description.ja: • 人体構造を徹底検証。筋肉の隆起から指先まで細部に宿るリアリティを追求。
description.en: • Thorough examination of human body structure. Pursuing the reality in every detail, from the bulges of the muscles to the tips of the fingers.

description.ja: • 進化した肩の引き出し構造により、可動域が向上。スーツに隠れている部分にもディテールを施し、筋肉を表現。
description.en: • Improved range of motion with improved shoulder drawer structure. The parts hidden in the suit are also detailed to express the muscles.

description.ja: • 可動によって生じる隙間を目立たせない関節構造。大胆なポージングでも身体のラインが崩れない。
description.en: • Joint structure that does not make the gaps caused by movement noticeable. Even in bold poses, the body line remains unchanged.

description.ja: • 成形色だけでカラーリングを表現。組み立てただけでカラフルな仕上がり。
description.en: • Express coloring only by molding color. Colorful finish just by assembly.

description.ja: • 胸・胴・腰のジョイント部可動域には、クリアランスを設けることで自然なポージングを実現。
description.en: • Clearance is provided in the range of motion of the chest, torso, and waist joints to achieve natural posing.

description.ja: • 特徴的な腕組みはパーツの差し替えで再現。立体物としての理想的な見え方を徹底追及。
description.en: • The characteristic folded arms can be reproduced by replacing parts. Thoroughly pursue the ideal way to view it as a three-dimensional object.

description.ja: • 豊富な表情・ハンドパーツ等の付属品で劇中の印象的なシーンを表現できる。
description.en: • You can express impressive scenes from the play with a wide variety of facial expressions, hand parts, and other accessories.

description.ja: • ディスプレイ用台座が付属。

accessories.en: Hand parts (left and right) x 5 types
